title: Template recipe
description: The settings a template exposes, and the exact LaTeX line each setting rewrites. A recipe is a sibling of template.yaml: recipe.yaml in the template's directory.

id.description: The template this recipe belongs to. Must match the template's own id.

knobs.description: The settings, in the order they are shown.

id.description: The key this setting is sent under.

label.description: The human-facing name of the setting.

type.description: color: a hex colour, normalised to bare uppercase hex. enum: one of options, used verbatim. number: a number, range-checked against min/max. length: a LaTeX length such as 0.75in. text: free text, LaTeX-escaped.

default.description: The value the template ships with. Rendering the default must appear exactly once in the template's cv.tex, or the template and the recipe disagree.

options.description: The allowed values, for the enum type.

latex.description: The LaTeX line this setting rewrites, with <<value>> where the value goes. Exactly one placeholder.
